artworks.title: Candle Stick
artworks.description: The image depicts a room with a large candle placed on a tall candlestick located centrally, under a coffered ceiling. The color palette consists mostly of black and white. To the right, there is a bench and a window with a decorative grid pattern, and beyond the window, there is an outdoor landscape with rocks. The room extends towards the rear with a wall featuring horizontal lines, suggesting texture or paneling. The room is compartmentalized, with the candlestick positioned prominently in the foreground, the bench and window to the right, and the background displaying a doorway and textured wall.

artworks.title: Shepherds Defending their Herds
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of sheep grazing and resting on a textured landscape. The point of view is slightly elevated, looking down onto the scene. In the background, there are hills and a structure resembling a tower or ruin on top of a hill. The horizon separates the terrain from the sky. On the left, a person is running, in the center another figure wields a staff, and to the right, a person is in combat with a wolf-like creature. The style is clean and precise, using crosshatching and linear strokes for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines against a light background.

artworks.title: The Crow and her Young
artworks.description: The image shows a solitary tree with intricate patterns on its trunk. A figure with a staff is walking to the right, gesturing off-screen. In the distance, hills and small structures are visible. The artwork features minimal yet detailed line work with a monochromatic color palette, creating a sense of balance and tranquility.

artworks.title: The Tulips and the Sun
artworks.description: The image shows an etching featuring a rocky formation to the right, framed by tulips on the left and right. The horizon is low, with the sun casting linear beams in the sky. Above, a flock of small birds is seen. The artwork has delicately etched dark lines capturing texture in the rock and flower petals. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of brown, and the style is intricate with tight, precise lines.

artworks.title: Burning Phoenix
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a landscape scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. In the center, there is a bird with outstretched wings over stylized flames or rising smoke. The horizon is placed above the midline, with rolling hills, sparse vegetation, and vertical elements. The style is minimal and linear, emphasizing contour over detail. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black against a light background. In the distance, two small human figures can be seen.

artworks.title: Crow and Snail
artworks.description: The image shows a snail on the ground with detailed lines on its shell. Above, a bird is flying with wings extended. In the background, there are hills, a few trees, a small structure, and sparse vegetation. The horizon divides the land from the clouds in the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, with expressive ink lines of varying thickness, using crosshatching and careful linework reminiscent of a classical etching style.

artworks.title: Serpent
artworks.description: The image shows a snake on rocky formations. The viewer looks at the scene directly. The horizon is hinted at the top of the rocks. The etching style uses consistent lines for texture and depth, especially in the shading of the rocks. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark and light contrasts typical of ink drawings. The snake is among the rocks, contrasting with the linear texture of the landscape.

artworks.title: Cat Watching Caged Bird
artworks.description: In the image, a cat is sitting on a ledge while looking up at a birdcage attached to the wall on the right. The color palette is monochromatic, with black line work on a light background. The cat is at the bottom left corner, and the birdcage is on the right. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with buildings, trees, and the distant horizon.

artworks.title: Two Knights
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rider on horseback in a dynamic pose in the foreground. Another rider on horseback is in the distance to the right, holding a weapon or lance upright. The background features hills, trees, and faint architectural forms. The artwork is characterized by detailed linework and crosshatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of black and white. The sky above is clear with horizontally spaced lines.

artworks.title: Stag in the Water
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with water, a shoreline with hills and buildings in the distance, birds flying, a rock and bare tree in the foreground, and a stag lying in the water. The artwork is created in detailed lines, likely using an etching technique, and is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia or black and white.

artworks.title: Bird Perched on a Thistle
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A bird is perched on a flower in the foreground. The horizon is positioned high in the composition, featuring hills and buildings in the distance. The drawing exhibits detailed, delicate line work, creating a monochromatic palette of black and cream. The simplicity of the drawing conveys a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Nightingale in a Bush
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a single tree and a bird on top. The horizon appears low in the composition with minimal clouds in the sky. The drawing style is pen and ink with detailed line work. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. The land stretches out with shrubs, uneven terrain, a small building, and fading hills in the background.

artworks.title: Eagle Losing an Old Feather
artworks.description: The image shows an expansive landscape with a bird flying centrally in the composition. The horizon line runs behind the bird, encompassing hills and a cluster of buildings to the right. The background features undulating hills. The drawing uses fine line work to suggest texture in the landscape and bird's feathers. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow in the sky. Closest to us, the landscape is sparse, while further back, there are more detailed buildings and hills.

artworks.title: Crane Flying
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white sketch with lush, bushy formations resembling clumps of dense foliage. In the forefront, these foliage clumps have small plants or branches growing on them. Small birds are perched on these plants and another bird is seen flying above, holding a twig. In the distance, a structure, potentially a tower, is visible on the left, with hints of calm water extending across the horizon. The horizon is positioned high, highlighting the mostly unadorned sky with minimal line work indicating distant clouds. The fine, linear brushstrokes and hatching create texture and depth, lending the scene a detailed and dynamic quality. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing the contrast between dark ink and light paper to define forms and textures.

artworks.title: Siren between Two Ships
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a maritime scene with a fantastical creature. The drawing shows two large sailing ships and a mythical mermaid-like figure playing a horn in the sea. To the left and right, there are large ships with full masts and flags. In the center, the creature has the body of a human but the tail of a fish, holding a horn. Rocks are visible in the foreground on the right. The style of the drawing reflects a classic depiction of maritime folklore, with detailed line work.

artworks.title: Crayfish Looking at the Sun
artworks.description: A large lobster on a rocky surface, with blades of grass to its right. The scene is in a monochrome sepia tone. In the background, the sun is partially above the horizon, radiating lines outward. The sea and sky extend behind the lobster.

artworks.title: Sun Rising
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with the horizon low in the composition. A quiet sea meets a small town in the distance, marked by medieval-looking towers and structures. Above, there is an artistic depiction of the sun with radiating lines. The sky has wispy clouds, created with curving strokes. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette of black ink, with the natural tone of the paper showing through. Closest to us, there are undulating shoreline lines suggesting the texture of sand and gentle waves, guiding the eye towards the detailed distant elements.

artworks.title: The Tomb
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an open sarcophagus with a skeleton inside. The image depicts a landscape scene with the foreground showing a detailed sarcophagus with a skeleton inside. The sarcophagus is open and intricately carved. On the left, two figures are present, draped in heavy garments as they observe the scene. In the background, there is a silhouette of a distant city or castle on a hill, surrounded by fields and a few scattered trees. The sky above is filled with stylized clouds.

artworks.title: Nun Embracing the Holy Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing upright, holding a large cross. The person has a delicately drawn face partially visible under a headscarf. The individual is dressed in long robes, with loose folds and a simple, flowing design. The person is depicted with a halo circling their head. The background consists of a lightly sketched landscape with distant hills and buildings to the right. The sky is plain and clear.

artworks.title: Narcissus Looking in the Water
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on a wooden beam over water, reaching towards their reflection. A tree trunk with branches is to the right, and a landscape with small trees is in the distance. Buildings are visible on the horizon. The artwork is detailed with fine lines, resembling an etching or ink drawing, and is monochromatic with dark lines against a light background.

artworks.title: Willows by the Water's Edge
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated ground across water towards a row of trees on the horizon. The trees are depicted with detailed lines, giving a sense of texture and movement. The color palette is limited to black and white. The sky is clear with hints of clouds.

artworks.title: Two Hearts
artworks.description: The image features two large rectangular pedestals or altars. The one on the left is topped by a flaming heart, while the one on the right holds a pair of shackles or handcuffs. The illustration is monochromatic, using varying shades of brown and tan to give it an aged appearance. In the background, a small building or structure can be seen in the distance, centered between the two pedestals. The scene is set against a plain horizon, and the pedestals occupy the front foreground of the image.

artworks.title: Peasant Whipping his Donkey
artworks.description: The image displays a man and a laden donkey walking from left to right. The horizon is low, showing distant hills and sparse trees. The illustration features delicate brushstrokes and a color palette of muted beige and black. A leafless tree is visible on the right side.

artworks.title: Gardener Pruning a Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a figure supporting a young tree. Buildings and trees are in the background, suggesting a horizon. The drawing features fine, precise lines in a monochromatic palette. The figure and tree are detailed, while distant structures are delicately outlined.
